title: Tunisian Corn Pastries
description: A floral and flaky pastry featuring creamed corn, deep-fried to a golden brown, this Tunisian dish is an indulgent treat that is friendly to low-calorie diets

ingredients.name: vegetable oil
ingredients.amount: 2 inches deep in a frying pan

instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine the sifted flour and cornstarch
Add the cream-style corn, melted butter, orange blossom water, and salt to the bowl and mix until a dough forms
Knead the dough for 5 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic
Divide the dough into 8 equal pieces and roll each piece into a ball
Roll out each ball into a thin circle
Heat the vegetable oil in a deep frying pan to 350 degrees
Carefully place each pastry in the hot oil and fry for 2-3 minutes on each side
Remove the pastries from the oil and place them on a paper towel-lined plate to drain excess oil
